release.item: Added full YouTube Music playlist editing: reorder tracks, edit descriptions, delete playlists, upload square-cropped covers, and export app playlists to YouTube
Added custom square cover image cropping and replacement for both YouTube Music and app-created playlists
Added a favorite toggle button directly in the playback notification player synced with YouTube Music likes
Added Follow and Following controls on YouTube Music artist pages synced with your YouTube subscriptions
Fixed album detail navigation so the top bar back button stays visible across screen transitions
Kept Add to Playlist exclusive to albums so playlist action bars remain symmetrical
Always display the album title next to the back button on album detail pages and keep the back button pill visible
Redesigned Statistics to match Verso's brand blue palette, cover-derived Recap hero card, and Outfit/Geist typography
Improved genre resolution with clean title matching, artist-level fallback caching, full band name preservation, and time-weighted top genres
Flushed remaining playback seconds on track change, skip, or repeat for accurate listening time totals
Hardened foreground playback service, network wake locks, notification resume, and YouTube stream recovery to prevent unexpected stops and app crashes
Extended the borderless progressive blur top bar and visible back button with collection titles across albums, playlists, library views, and artist pages
Redesigned artist pages with larger artwork, Outfit headings, cover-derived atmospheric gradients, and refined action controls
Balanced album and collection action bars with an Add to Playlist button, removed duplicate download badges, and added playlist deletion for app-created playlists
Synced in-app favorite toggles with YouTube Music likes
Fixed search history persistence to keep the last 5 searches visible with View All and Clear All actions, removed YouTube labels, and refined search results

Fixed artist name clipping on square artwork cards and upgraded Compasso with Unicode normalization, accurate band/title parsing, legacy Room key support, usable buffer counting, thread-safe queue fills, and background playback tracking
Refined the top bar with a simple progressive blur separating the greeting and tab title from the floating profile and menu pill
Added Spotify account sign-in with Android Keystore encryption in Playlists to browse and open your Spotify playlists with track counts
Fixed the Add to Playlist picker so all YouTube Music and local playlists can be scrolled and selected
Fixed Now Playing audio quality display to read real codec and bitrate from ExoPlayer tracks instead of falling back to YouTube
Fixed update version comparison for codename releases and prioritized the stable release tag for update checks
Introduced a new Verso visual identity with Outfit display typography, Geist body copy, neutral surfaces, and a 4dp spacing grid across Library, Search, Playlists, Albums, Artists, and Settings
Redesigned the top bar on Home, Library, Playlists, and Search with a single translucent pill for account and menu actions, three-dot menu icon, and borderless edge
Redesigned the bottom navigation bar with a brand-blue selection pill, consistent icons, and readable labels, and updated mini player geometry
Added contrast-safe cover color tinting to currently playing list rows and album and playlist headers, alongside larger covers matching the player radius
Added a 4-tone category accent palette for Mixes, Discover, Downloads, and Favorites section headers and refined UI motion to 150–250 ms
Encrypted Last.fm session storage with Android Keystore, added a persistent offline scrobble queue, and added ListenBrainz integration
Added full YouTube Music playlist editing (rename, search and add songs, remove tracks) and YouTube playlist selection in Add to Playlist
Added library JSON export/import (Verso, Spotify, Last.fm), playlist import by YouTube Music or Spotify link with cover art, and offline download for created and imported playlists
Added offline romanization (Japanese, Korean, Cyrillic) and on-demand translation to the lyrics view
Added Wi-Fi auto-download for liked tracks, artist blocking in Compasso, and improved queue and playback position persistence
Redesigned home screen widgets with Verso branding, compact sizing, blue playback controls, live synced lyrics in Nova, and fixed widget buttons in release builds
Upgraded Share Cards with live highlighted lyrics, richer song metadata, and Stories 9:16 export
Updated GitHub update checker API header for reliable automatic update checks
Redesigned album and playlist detail screens with integrated in-collection track search, total duration metadata, and a centered single-row action bar
Updated artist pages with dynamic artwork palette headers and centered playback controls
Removed local device music UI from onboarding, library, search, and settings for a focused streaming experience
Fixed YouTube Music watch history syncing and Last.fm scrobbling authentication
Added the Compasso continuous recommendation engine with infinite queue flow, real-time session affinity, 1-in-5 artist diversity window, and ATV studio audio purity filtering
Added Familiar, 70/30, and Explore discovery modes in the queue panel with instant upcoming queue adaptation
Refined album and playlist detail screens with dynamic artwork palette headers, centered play controls, and downloaded confirmation badges
Fixed overlapping queue items during batch updates and updated privacy policy settings copy to Verso across all 40 languages
Updated app identity with the final ver/so icon across launcher, Material You themed icon, onboarding, About, Stats, Recap, and Share Cards
Redesigned Home with an editorial magazine layout featuring Featured hero, Pick up again, New releases, Essentials, numbered Trending chart, Explore by mood, and pull-to-refresh
Added dedicated See All and Explore by mood screens with full in-app language support
Improved music recommendations and musically coherent auto-queue for YouTube tracks
Redesigned Downloads with an instant Collections grid and a virtualized Songs tab with A–Z, Album, and Artist filters
Redesigned Favorites and consolidated Favorites and Downloads exclusively inside Library
Replaced character-splitting lyrics highlighting with a flicker-free smooth sweep and progressive focal blur
Improved YouTube Music watch history syncing reliability and updated the Verso privacy policy
Rebranded to Verso with a new Option 1 adaptive icon and redesigned About screen
Added YouTube Music streaming, account login, synced favorites, library browsing, and Activity Mix on Home
Added fast chunked offline downloads with offline playback for downloaded albums and playlists
Added BetterLyrics word-by-word synced lyrics with customizable provider priority and LRCLIB fallback
Added Last.fm integration with automatic 30-second scrobbling and genre discovery
Added Last.fm-style listening stats in Library and a shareable Verso Recap story experience
Redesigned the Now Playing player, floating minimal navigation capsule, and album/playlist views
Added audio quality controls and music cache/download management in Settings
UI tweaks in equalizer, lyrics and tag editing screen
Added basic tablet layout support in horizontal orientation
Added support for the app to work on Huawei devices with Kirin CPUs
